title: Mutable EpochFloorAuthority can lower a bound trackers firmware floor
description: Timing security review: StratumTracker retains a live EpochFloorAuthority but does not snapshot or validate its immutable build epoch, provision verifier binding, or maximum lead. A caller can use object.__setattr__ to lower the private build field or swap verifier/lead after tracker construction, then admit timestamps below the configured firmware floor. Add an immutable floor-authority binding snapshot that preserves live provision updates while rejecting mutation of build, verifier identity, and lead. Test lower/higher build mutation, verifier swap, lead change, and valid provision advancement on adopt, current_time, and status.
